relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: Cyclooxygenase 2, an enzyme involved in the synthesis of prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) from arachidonic acid

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: PGE2-dependent sensitization promotes increased neurotransmitter release including release of CGRP and substance P

key_findings: PGE2 was lower in AP/RAP than symptomatic controls in 10-20 min pancreas fluid and plasma, and did not distinguish AP/RAP from CP.
MMP7 and MMP9 were higher in pancreas fluid from CP than AP/RAP; CGRP was rarely detected.
